SELECT COUNT(c.customer_id) AS customers_without_completed_order
FROM marts.dim_customers AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
    WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id
      AND o.status = 'completed'
)
output.explanation: Counts customers with no order of status 'completed', including customers who have never ordered at all. I assumed "completed" means the status value is exactly 'completed'.
